hero.lede: CS at Queen's, AI consultant at RBC Dominion Securities, co-chair of Queen's Web Dev. I find the slow, manual work and kill it.

about.heading: Fast, clean, easy to work with.
paragraphs: I'm a computer science student at Queen's, specializing in cognitive science, and these days my focus is putting AI to work where it actually earns its keep. At RBC Dominion Securities I work with an advisor's desk to find the slow, repetitive parts of their day and rebuild them with AI — cutting the busywork so they can move faster on what matters.

I'm also co-chair of Queen's Web Development, where I'm building the club itself: setting up how it runs, growing the team and its programs, and expanding the community around learning to build for the web.

Outside of that, I'm always building something. I work across AI and software, I move quickly, and I care about the details most people skip. I'm confident with the hard problems — and easy to work with on them.

roles.desc: Finding the slow, manual parts of an advisor's desk and rebuilding them with AI. Full-time over the summer, part-time through term.
Running the club and growing it. This term: shipped the new site, started the curriculum, and got first-years building at their first event.

items.text: Go deep on what the job actually requires. Not what it looks like it requires from outside.
Then find every way to do it. All of them, before you fall for the first one.
Then pick the best one you can actually build. A solution you can't ship isn't one.
